description: The Agriculture Asset Inventory web map and app describe food producers, processors, community facilities and related services across Anishinabek communities. Source metadata identifies nursing homes, schools, daycares, wells and utility lines among mapped context. Two application items resolve to the same native app ID, while the public web-map description explicitly names the inventory application. A related Farm Services layer locates Northern Ontario production, processing and distribution services, including dairies and creameries; it cites a 2017 directory and a May 2020 import. These related components retain separate scope, and full layer equivalence is not claimed. The app was developed in 2021; current completeness and operating status are unverified. Native terms restrict the app to information sharing and caution that some reuse needs permission. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Anishinabek Nation Lands and Resources Department; source-specific creators retained. Licence: Native ArcGIS source-specific terms: information-sharing or educational/analytical use where stated; standard licence unstated. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says public; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
